assessment: ZMYM2 is a transcriptional corepressor but little was known about how it is recruited to chromatin. This important study reveals that ZMYM2 homes to distinct classes of retrotransposons bound by the TRIM28 and ChAHP complexes in human cells, which is broadly relevant for the field of transcriptional regulation. Much of the evidence supporting the claims of the authors is convincing. Since widespread ZMYM2-mediated control of transposon activity is not apparent in RNA-seq data, further experiments are needed to demonstrate a more general role beyond the retrotransposons analysed in this study.
